title: Seabreeze retail LLM sprint notes
content:
Sprint notes / raw capture (working doc) - Seabreeze (regional retail chain)

Context: Seabreeze is piloting an in-store returns assistant + quick-recommendation feature. They want a hybrid flow: edge inference for offline low-latency checks (receipt OCR + short-chat), with hosted Redwood fallback for complex policy/legal text and heavy rerank/embedding queries. Customer is highly cost sensitive on token spend across millions of weekly receipts.

Meeting 2025-02-11 - kickoff w/ Seabreeze eng + ops (Chris M. / Lina S.)
- Attendees: Diego (Redwood), Priya (SE), Tom (Solutions), Chris Morton (Seabreeze Eng), Lina Soto (Seabreeze Ops)
- Goal: align on constraints, initial success criteria, and minimal viable infra for pilot stores (50 stores).

Key takeaways
- Latency SLOs: 95th pctl end-to-end <= 250ms for common flows (barcode/receipt parse + response) when on-network. Offline/local should be <= 120ms for cached receipts (edge inference).
- Privacy: PII must never leave store for >80% of interactions (they will classify transactions as sensitive vs non-sensitive).
- Connectivity: intermittent (satellite fallback) expected in ~12% of stores during peak. Need graceful fallback to async queued calls when offline (store agent processes later).
- Cost target: < $0.01 per interaction averaged across all flows (incl. embeddings for recall/rerank amortized).
- Models: Seabreeze prefers open models / customer-managed weights for legal/compliance reasons if on-prem. They are open to hosted Redwood for non-sensitive.

Initial technical constraints / environment
- Edge hardware: Intel NUC class machines (4-core, 16GB) in POS closet at pilot stores. GPU not available on-edge.
- Central infra: VPC with restricted egress; they want Private deployment or dedicated capacity in us-east for pilot.
- Average prompt length: 120 tokens (receipt short text) => typical response 40-80 tokens. Peak QPS per store ~2-3.
- Embedding index: will be a local index per region (sharded) for returns/rule lookup. Suggest using small-dim embeddings (384) for base retrieval to save cost.

Preliminary design ideas (sketch)
1) On-edge micro-inference using quantized 7B (FP4/4-bit) for classification + short responses. Use Redwood Private runtime w/ model pinned; continuous batching disabled (low concurrency).
2) If network available and request flagged non-sensitive -> route to hosted Redwood model (larger 13B or 33B) with reranker for policies + embedding recall (global index).
3) Sensitive flows always stay on Private or on-edge and result syncs to central only as hashed telemetry (no raw PII).
4) Cache: prefix + KV cache for common receipt templates (saves tokens). Maintain per-store cache TTL 6 hours.

Gotchas / risk areas
- Token inflation from OCR noise: receipts are noisy; naive prompts include raw OCR and blow up token counts. Need OCR normalization pipeline (strip timestamps, noise) or use an extraction step (server-side or on-edge) to only send structured fields.
- No GPU on-edge => even 7B quantized might be slow on NUC. Need to prototype with LLama-2-7B-int8/4bit and measure p50/p95. Possibly fall back to micro-classifier on-edge + server for generation.
- VPC egress rules: Seabreeze security requires allowlist only; initial Private control plane config may need firewall exceptions and static IPs. Prep ticket RDW-3417 (security) to collect NAT IPs.
- Embedding sync: local index must be periodically reconciled with central master without sending raw PII. Need strategy: sync vectors + metadata IDs; central store maps to redacted content.

Prompting / example patterns (for engineers to test)
- Extraction-first pattern: "EXTRACT: scan_text -> transaction_date, total, line_items (qty, sku, price), merchant_name" (returns JSON). Then short-chat uses only JSON.
- Short answer template (edge): "Return reason and next step: given transaction {items}, policy {local_rules}, produce 1-line outcome and code (OK/REJECT/ESCALATE). Max tokens 40."
- Rerank flow (hosted): retrieval top-20 embedding candidates -> rerank with model + policy simulator. Score threshold 0.75 for auto-approve.

Metrics / success criteria (pilot)
- Functional: correct returns outcome accuracy >= 94% on curated eval set (500 receipts).
- Latency: 95th pctl <= 250ms when on-network, <= 120ms for common cached edge checks.
- Ops: mean downtime across pilot stores < 0.5% per month.
- Cost: avg cost per interaction < $0.01 after caching & batching optimizations.

Immediate action items (owner - ETA)
- Run edge perf prototype (Priya) - benchmark Llama-2-7B quantized on NUC; report p50/p95 for classification + small generation -> due 2025-02-20.
- OCR normalization rules (Seabreeze): deliver sample noisy receipts (Chris) -> due 2025-02-18.
- Security intake: RDW-3417 (Tom) -> collect NAT IPs, compliance checklist -> due 2025-02-21.
- Embedding index design doc (Diego) -> outline local/global sync, metadata redaction -> due 2025-02-25.
- Pricing sketch for pilot (Tom + Diego) -> include dedicated private capacity cost vs hosted mixed -> due 2025-02-24.

Open questions / decisions needed
- Do they want the control plane hosted (Redwood) or Private control plane in their VPC for pilot? Tradeoffs: Private control plane speeds compliance signoff but increases ops overhead. Need decision by 2025-02-19.
- Edge model lifecycle: who will push quantized updates? Redwood push vs customer-managed artifacts. Identify SRE owner.
- Embedding vector dim tradeoff: 384 vs 768 (cost vs recall). Run recall vs cost experiment.

Notes to self / informal:
- Chris mentioned they use Clover POS variants (some older models) — might need different connector for receipts. Follow up with concrete POS model list.
- Slack channel created: #seabreeze-onramp (linked above). Use for quick sync + alert routing.
- Keep evaluation set private; Seabreeze will provide 1k synthetic receipts for early tests.

Next meeting: 2025-02-21 10:00 PT (tech deep dive: edge prototype results + security intake).

Misc quick commands / tickets to create (for backlog)
- Create RDW-3478: edge-inference-prototype-run (priya)
- Create RDW-3479: ocr-normalization-rules (seabreeze sample)
- Create RDW-3480: private-control-plane-checklist

End of sprint raw notes. Will convert to polished onboarding playbook once edge perf numbers land.

-- Diego
